description:
Hushfeed v0.45.1 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Two fixes for TikTok 46.9.3. Feed filter no longer closes the app when the Following feed loads, and a download with no clean address falls back to the video's playback address again. Both came from fields that build renamed, and a new check now looks up every TikTok field Hushfeed uses in each retained build.

Validation: 1430 runtime tests passed locally, plus 241 patch tests. The bundle carries 91 patches and a non-empty classes.dex. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
